notes: Kev-0.8B (litert-community/Kev-0.8B-LiteRT, Hub commit 98fec4a5828c7f31b1ffd062f738f5c8a1e4ab8d, public, read from the Hub API 2026-10-04); source jaredpalmer/kev-0.8b @ v1.0 (Apache-2.0): Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base (rev dc7cdfe2, Apache-2.0) + a rank-16 LoRA + a pointer head, merged with the author's scripts/merge_lora_checkpoint.py in fp32; d = 1024, head temperature 2.3510958125672174. Typed decisions (noul / choice / score) over a state and a question: the request is rendered with the author's to_record + encode (Kev repo tokenizer.json, separator ids state 248060 / question 248061 / option 248049 and 248050 / decide 248062), one row per question (state + question + options). Graph = state-free row prefill, one signature serving_default: ids int32 [1,L] (right-padded with 248044) + valid float32 [1,L] -> hidden float32 [1,L,d] (after the final RMSNorm, every position); positions, causal mask and the pad-key mask are inside the graph; no KV / conv / recurrent state in or out. L = 512 / 1024 / 2048 = three files with the same weights, chosen by row length. The pointer head (q / k projections, head_dim 256, temperature) and the answer shaping run on the host in fp32. Storage: FULLY_CONNECTED weights fp16 (FLOAT_CASTING, DEQUANTIZE to fp32), embedding table int8 (the GPU delegate takes an in-graph EMBEDDING_LOOKUP table only as int8). GpuOptions(precision = FP32) is the validated GPU setting. Reference for the parity metrics = the author's torch fp32 oracle at tag kev-1.0 (CPU, 377 requests / 402 questions: transfer-v4 development slices, SemIf authored144, own records, one red-arm row that differs from tv4_000 by one word). artifact_sha256 = the line for kev-0.8b_rowprefill_L1024_fp16fc_i8emb.tflite in the staged SHA256SUMS, equal to the Hub LFS oid (API tree read 2026-10-04) and to the sha256 the device runs recorded (device/graphs.sha256, device/r6/inputs_r6.json). soc from the phone's own logcat line 'Gnss chipset vendor=qcom / chipInfo=SM8850' (device/r6/kev_s26_r6_E_4b.logcat_all_since_start.txt).
